discrepancies.statement: Guide 8.8 step 5 and scenario E6: 'Reject only the quote' puts the ticket back to In Progress.
discrepancies.reality: The ticket stays on Hold (SLA still paused) and moves to the vendor's Part required box with the quote items (no prices). Only cancelTicket=true cancels.

discrepancies.statement: Appendix A, Auto-close: 'Runs whenever someone opens the Home page (there is no scheduled job)'. Sections 8.11 and 9 say job csat every 30 minutes.
discrepancies.reality: Auto-close is done by /api/csat/run (every 30 min, all organisations); the Home trigger is only a legacy extra for managers. The guide contradicts itself.

discrepancies.statement: Appendix A: Permission matrix has 'four switches'.
discrepancies.reality: Six policy keys exist (global_settings_write, business_rules_write, workflow_edit, intake_priority_override, external_invites, report_recipients). Guide section 2.4 lists six.

discrepancies.statement: Guide 8.10: time periods 7/30/60/90/120 days, FY.
discrepancies.reality: Period options are 30d, 60d, 90d, 120d, fy and custom; no 7-day option (Appendix A is right).

discrepancies.statement: Guide 8.10 lists drag-and-drop widgets as part of the Smart Dashboard.
discrepancies.reality: @dnd-kit widget reordering exists only in AnalyticsDashboard (/dashboards and /admin/reports), not in the Smart Dashboard (Appendix A says normal dashboards).

discrepancies.statement: Guide 8.10: calendar days are yellow when >10% and red when >30% over the group's normal.
discrepancies.reality: The 10%/30% rule applies to the share of faulty ACs (AC/genset calendar). Groups without assets use the median and busiest-15% level of the last 90 days.

discrepancies.statement: Appendix A lists Requester as a user of the Smart Dashboard, Place picker, Faulty AC calendar and Day pop-up ('one dashboard for every role'). Section 4 says requesters get Home only.
discrepancies.reality: /dashboards/executive redirects role user to /home and the sidebar hides it from requesters. Section 4 is right; Appendix A 'Who' is wrong for those rows (the requester level copy in levels.ts is unreachable).

discrepancies.statement: Section 4: Reports - requester: no.
discrepancies.reality: Report Builder (/reports/pivot) is open to every signed-in role with the Requests module; a requester sees only their own tickets (scope own). Other entities stay manager+.

discrepancies.statement: Appendix A: Knowledge Base used by Requester and Technician.
discrepancies.reality: The only Knowledge Base screen is /admin/knowledge-base (manager, admin, platform owner); no requester-facing article page was found.

discrepancies.statement: Appendix A 'Roles ... each with its own pages and rights' and section 7 Roles screen.
discrepancies.reality: Admin > Roles permission matrix (custom roles / overrides) is read-only and labelled 'Not enforced - Coming soon'; toggles change nothing. Only the five fixed roles are enforced.

discrepancies.statement: Section 6.1 transition table.
discrepancies.reality: Agents may also move Waiting on User -> Resolved; requesters may move Waiting on User -> Open and -> Cancelled; agents cannot cancel from Waiting on User or Hold (Hold -> Cancelled exists only for a system PO rejection). Table says Open/Assigned/... -> Cancelled.

discrepancies.statement: Section 9 scheduled job list.
discrepancies.reality: install-cron-tasks.ps1 also registers CitykartDesk-Cron-Visits (job visit-automation, every 15 min) for the dropped engineer-visit module. cron-tick.mjs has no such job, so it would call /api/visit-automation/run (no such route) and log a failure every 15 minutes. Re-running the installer on the server would create it.

discrepancies.statement: Sheet copies run at 11:00, 15:00, 19:00 (section 8.7, 9).
discrepancies.reality: Times agree with schedule.ts and the installer, but the route comment in app/api/masters/sync/route.ts says 'Scheduled job (every minute)' and docs/SHEET-MASTERS-GUIDE.md still says three sheets (now four).

discrepancies.statement: Section 8.8 / 12: the PO default approver is the single approver set in Admin > Vendors.
discrepancies.reality: When no approver is set, code falls back to a hard-coded person's company e-mail address (DEFAULT_PO_APPROVER_EMAIL) found in auth users.

discrepancies.statement: Appendix A, SLA escalation and alert rules 'at 15-minute checks'.
discrepancies.reality: Scheduled Business Rules (SLA %, unassigned minutes) run every 15 min; alert rules (unassigned requests, task/milestone alerts) run in the alerts job every 30 min.

discrepancies.statement: Appendix A, Daily alert digest: 'One summary mail every morning at 08:00'.
discrepancies.reality: The digest is an in-app notification to the alert rule's roles (manager, admin by default); an e-mail goes out only when the rule has the email channel. The hour test uses server local time (getHours()===8), not explicit India time.

discrepancies.statement: Section 11: 'Unit (about 1,560 tests)'.
discrepancies.reality: A count of it/test declarations in tests/unit gives about 1,405 (before it.each expansion). Cannot confirm 1,560 without running.

discrepancies.statement: Section 2.3: 184 numbered migrations (000 ... 184); rollbacks kept from 164.
discrepancies.reality: There are 184 files because number 176 does not exist (175 -> 177); there is no 176 rollback.

discrepancies.statement: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md vs the guide.
discrepancies.reality: ARCHITECTURE.md states Next.js 16.2.9 (package.json: 16.3.8), e-mail via Resend (code: SMTP, Resend only as fallback), deployment 'local only' (CLAUDE.md: production on 10.0.1.98), 87 migrations (184), in-process rate limiting only, and has no vendor/PMS/sheet masters. The guide calls it partly outdated.

discrepancies.statement: HANDOVER.md (old session note) vs the guide.
discrepancies.reality: HANDOVER.md says Docker is not running, describes a single-admin model and QA leftovers, and treats SLA escalation as Business Rules; the guide section 5 still lists escalation_policies / sla_escalation_rules / sla_escalation_events as current tables. Code reads sla_escalation_rules only in the one-time conversion action.

discrepancies.statement: Guide 8.9(4) and docs/AC-PMS.md: PMS tickets are not counted in the AC Ticket Calendar and AC complaint reports.
discrepancies.reality: No PMS check exists in the calendar or report code. Exclusion happens only because those read categories with auto_oem_kind ac/genset and services with auto_oem_routing, so it holds only if the AC-PMS category/service lack those flags. Untested.

discrepancies.statement: Guide 8.5e: last 5 decisions of the same store and sub-category in the last 12 months.
discrepancies.reality: Rows also include approvals still waiting; the window is 12 x 31 days; at most 100 earlier approvals are read (totals could be understated for very large histories).

discrepancies.statement: Section 10.1: job routes without x-cron-secret return 401.
discrepancies.reality: They return 401 for a missing/wrong secret but 503 when CRON_SECRET is not configured on the server.

discrepancies.statement: Guide and Appendix: vendor dashboard has 7 boxes.
discrepancies.reality: Code and tests agree (7), but a code comment in lib/vendor/access.ts and the test title 'the six boxes' still say six.

discrepancies.statement: Comment in lib/constants/request-transitions.ts points to tests/vapt/23-business-rule-limits.test.ts.
discrepancies.reality: That file does not exist; the matching test is tests/vapt/23-permission-matrix-and-rules.test.ts.

discrepancies.statement: Guide 8.11 / Appendix: a low CSAT rating alerts managers.
discrepancies.reality: Ratings of 1-2 stars notify the technician who handled the ticket and the leads of its group (bell).

discrepancies.statement: Guide 8.2: Qty appears for FIXTURES/HANGERS.
discrepancies.reality: Depends on the form configuration; the automated test only proves Qty for the Fixture category and absence elsewhere.

discrepancies.statement: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md vs the guide.
discrepancies.reality: No contradiction found: guide section 0 (no push, no deploy, test locally) is consistent with CLAUDE.md; CLAUDE.md production topology is not repeated in the guide.
